text_block_list.name: Transfer Student
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh, starting today, I'm a Tracen 
Academy student too, huh. I wonder if I'll 
be able to get along okay...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me—excuse me, transfer student over 
there.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Starting life in a new place must feel 
quite daunting. However, please do not 
worry.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"You have me... This Saint, Red Desire, by 
your side."

text_block_list.name: Transfer Student
text_block_list.text: Huh... A-A Saint??

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am a saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So that her heart may pursue its dreams 
free of grief— let me bestow a blessing as 
her classmate.

text_block_list.name: Transfer Student
text_block_list.text:
......Classmates? Th-thank you... very 
much...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Desire-chaaan! Hehe. I knew you'd come out 
to greet the transfer student.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm Buena Vista. I'm in your class, too. 
Nice to meet you♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Your first day of school is always so 
nerve-wracking, isn't it...! I was stiff 
as a board back then.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Being wide awake and unable to sleep until 
morning. Not even noticing my collar was 
crooked.

text_block_list.name: Transfer Student
text_block_list.text:
...! I understand completely...! To be 
honest, I'm still nervous right now...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, that's terrible! Here, take my 
hand. Let us cast away the darkness trying 
to encroach upon your heart.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: May my mana become your strength.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"This is the Ritto Dormitory. Starting 
today, you shall be living alongside us as 
well."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Are you a transfer student? 
Pleased to meet you, my name is Victoire 
Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
As a fellow dorm resident, I look forward 
to working with you. Please allow me to 
show you around inside as well.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, not too long ago, 
we welcomed another transfer student. A 
girl in the same grade as me, actually."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If you wouldn't mind... Shall we hold a 
tea party with them sometime?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
As fellow transfer students, you can build 
a connection and share all sorts of things 
together.

text_block_list.name: Transfer Student
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really? That would be a huge 
help...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to reach out to me anytime, 
okay? Whether it's at the dorms or in the 
classroom!

text_block_list.name: Transfer Student
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone is so kind. Maybe... maybe I 
really can manage this...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, it seemed like the transfer 
student was able to completely relax.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This, too, is all thanks to everyone 
lending a helping hand.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Devoting one's heart to stay close and 
show care. Truly, the conduct of a 
heroine.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
An angelic benevolence that embraces all, 
never leaving anyone alone. The comforting 
power of connection.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"As a Saint, it made me realize once again 
that I must follow that example."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"So... if you would be willing, would you 
care to have a tea party among the three 
of us from time to time?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Watching the dedication of you two every 
day, I want to grow into a true saint...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My, by all means♪ It brings me great joy 
to form a new bond.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! Having a tea party with everyone 
sounds so fun...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“—And that is the origin of this 'Holy 
Maiden's Tea Party.'”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I'm kind of just having fun normally 
here, but... am I actually being helpful 
to you, Desire-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! There is so much to learn 
from the two of you, from your casual 
gestures to your words.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I've grown even more 
refined as a saintly maiden, and more and 
more people have come to rely on me, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness... I, too, am always 
grateful that you share such fascinating 
things with me at every tea party."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I will be sure to introduce you both 
to other things you might enjoy.
choice_data_list:
Is that from an isekai series or 
something?

Could that be one of the puzzles Desire 
likes?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I've been recommending isekai 
reincarnation otome games to the two of 
them.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Buena-san usually reaches the main hero's 
ending in almost any game, you know.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because... the more I read the story, the 
more I felt like the main hero had to be 
the one for this heroine!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, Pisa-san only ever gets 
the True Ending where everyone is happy, 
or the Ending where she flags no one at 
all... It is delightfully extreme.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Choosing someone means not choosing 
someone else... I just find that so 
difficult.
choice_data_list:
Your playstyle really shows your 
personality.

Your playstyle really shows your 
personality, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is quite fascinating to see how 
everyone carries themselves, isn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. There are also puzzles everyone can 
enjoy cooperatively, so I like to partake 
in those.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I have omitted the types of 
puzzles involving untangling things, so 
you can enjoy it with peace of mind.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Joining forces to connect the pieces and 
arrive at the solution... What a wonderful 
pastime.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I found a really difficult-looking 
puzzle the other day... Want to try it? I 
feel like the three of us could solve it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! If we join forces, we'll 
be unstoppable♪
